cases.name: Teresa Joann Peroni
cases.about: Friends described her as a free spirit.
cases.narrative: She vanished after attending a gathering near Selma, Oregon, with witnesses reporting that she entered the forested area accompanied by her then-boyfriend, Sanfratello. Her skull was discovered in 1997 and later identified through DNA analysis.
